chapter: Leaving Stuff Smith; Benny Carter and Fletcher Henderson
title: After Stuff: Benny Carter's band, then the whole band goes to Fletcher Henderson
summary: Stuff left for Buffalo after Blatt's Beer Garden; Jones joined Benny Carter's irregular band, then the entire band left for Fletcher Henderson at Roseland without giving notice.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: on it, you know. So then he went back to Buffalo, so that was all. We finished at Blatt's Beer Garden. That was it. And that's when I come into New York and we waited around. I went down to the booking office, and they said, "Well, it looks like he's going to stay there, because he'll get himself in trouble if he ever comes here to work, because he's got a contract with us." I said, well, I don't have time to wait for him, you know. So they said, "Well, Jonah, what are you going to do?" So I said, "I'm going to work with Benny Carter," because Benny Carter had a band, and we went to work with Benny. This was '40. Went to work with Benny Carter. There was Pop Smith, Bobby Williams and myself. So we went into Roseland and stayed there awhile with Fletcher, you know. No, what we did, it was with Benny Carter, but we left Benny, the whole band, the whole band in that same year. We made some records with Benny, then everybody left Benny because Benny was going out of town. Every now and then he'd have a gig, you know, maybe two or three gigs, sometimes one a week, and so Fletcher's going into Roseland, so the entire band left Fletcher and went into Roseland with Fletcher.
Left Benny and went into Roseland with Fletcher.
Yeah, went into Roseland with Fletcher.
Well, how did Benny take that?
I don't know, I didn't ask him . We just

all quite. You didn't have to give no notice, see, when you're not working steady. You just leave, you know. So we all went with Fletcher. And I never heard Benny say anything about it, because I went to his house after that and everything. You know, he lived close to me uptown, and so I'd go by during the day and he never said nothing.
